description: Policies chosen in one chock selection, packaged as one plugin. Friction, not a security boundary.
disclaimer: These policies add friction to an agent's mistakes; they are not a security boundary.

steps.note: Both commands are safe to repeat. The plugin loads in place from the directory: restart the Claude Code session, or run /reload-plugins in it, to pick up a rebuild.
VS Code finds plugins the Copilot CLI installed. Without the CLI, add the plugin folder to your VS Code user settings yourself:

codex.name: Codex
codex.label_prefix: once its hooks are trusted in /hooks:

steps.note: Then install __PLUGIN__ from the __MARKETPLACE__ marketplace in /plugins, and review and trust its hooks in /hooks: until you do, they do not run.
Cursor loads __PLUGIN_DIR__ as a local plugin: run "Developer: Reload Window" (or restart Cursor), then check it under Customize. There is no command to run.

On Windows, `devin plugins install --local` creates a symbolic link, so it needs Developer Mode (Settings > System > For developers) or an elevated shell; otherwise it fails with "os error 1314: A required privilege is not held by the client".
The plugin is linked in place: a rebuild applies from the next Devin session.

goose discovers __PLUGIN_DIR__ as a user plugin, in every project: start a new goose session. There is no command to run (`goose plugin install` takes a git URL only). To turn it off, add __PLUGIN__ to disabledPlugins in ~/.config/goose/settings.json.

Plugins are off in grok until enabled, and chock does not edit grok's config: run `grok plugin list` for the name grok gave this plugin (chock expects __PLUGIN__, its folder name; the docs do not say how a plugin with no plugin.json is named), then `grok plugin enable <name>`, or add it to `enabled` under [plugins] in ~/.grok/config.toml, or press Space on it in the Plugins tab. Re-run the install command after a rebuild.

Antigravity 2.0 and the IDE read plugin folders from ~/.gemini/config/plugins/ instead: copy __PLUGIN_DIR__ there. Its hooks name __PLUGIN_DIR__ by absolute path (Antigravity documents no plugin-root variable), so keep that folder where it is; re-run the install command after a rebuild.
